events.description: TEXT ORDER: These matters come before the court on Plaintiffs' motion to remand [DE 16], Plaintiffs' motion to expedite consideration of the motion to remand [DE 18], and the North Carolina Alliance for Retired Americans' (the Alliance's) motion to intervene [DE 1-13]. The court GRANTS the Alliance permissive intervention pursuant to Rule 24(b) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure. The court further finds good cause to GRANT Plaintiffs' motion to expedite. See Dietz v. Bouldin, 579 U.S. 40, 47 (2016). Defendants and the Alliance shall file any response in opposition to the motion to remand on or before October 21, 2024. Plaintiffs shall file any reply on or before October 25, 2024. After receipt of written submissions, the court will promptly set this matter for hearing if the court deems one necessary. Entered by Chief U.S. District Judge Richard E. Myers II on 10/16/2024. (Copy of order mailed to Narendra K. Ghosh, Patterson Harkavy LLP, 100 Europa Drive, Suite 420, Chapel Hill, NC 27217,) (McNally, Kimberly)
